name: Hot foil
sub: A metallic film, not a color. It conforms to the tooth, skips the deepest valleys, and its brightness is the light: a broad studio reflection plus tight glints off every facet. Holographic foil shifts hue with each facet's angle.

entry.call: fx.run(o, W, H, dpr, { S, clips })

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.clips: Float32Array alpha per name (die), from FXSET.clips('fx-08-foil', W, H, dpr, o) on a thread with fonts
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, absorbance / coverage (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, stock height (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes — every random draw is a hash of (position, seed); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

params.label: Die
params.note: what the die (or type) is: an invented mark (compass, sun, crescent, knot, a monogram from the text), a word, or a ring seal

params.label: Text
params.note: set in Archivo 800 for word, seal and monogram (its first letter)

params.label: Size
params.note: die height as a share of the plate

params.label: Foil · C

limits.why: most hues leave sRGB above ~.26 and get chroma-reduced

params.note: OKLCH chroma; reduced at constant L/h if it leaves sRGB

params.label: Soft-box size
params.note: small exponent = big soft box (broad sweep); large = small hard light

params.label: Camera distance
params.note: viewer height in plate widths — closer = a stronger sweep of the reflection across the foil

params.label: Crush
params.note: how much the heated die flattens the tooth under the foil

params.label: Release
params.note: lowest share of the surface that the foil never touches (pinholes)

params.label: Edge flash
params.note: foil breaking at the die edge

params.label: Seed
params.note: every random draw in the effect hangs off this one number

recipe: Die = the same shapes as FX-06; foil lands on the AA die × the stock: valleys below the starve height release no foil (pinholes), edge flash breaks the boundary at the film-split scale.
Height = stock relief × (1 − crush) + foil grain (fine crumple) − a slight deboss; normals from it.

Metal: a perspective viewer above the plate; the mirror vector per pixel samples a soft box at the sheet light (and a weak fill opposite), so the reflection sweeps across the foil; + tight Blinn glints; holo rotates the hue by facet orientation.
Off-foil paper keeps its own light.

limits.what: reads as metallic paint, not foil
foil goes dark — metal reflects away from an overhead light
